_help: The jobs the automatic pipeline works through, in order, every day (see docs/PIPELINE.md). kind "notes" = the full revision notes. kind "custom" = anything else: give it a prompt (placeholders {board} {subject} {code} {tier} {paper} {topic} {point} {others}), the fields the AI's JSON reply must contain, and a folder of its own under content/ to save into. Set enabled to true to switch a job on. specs / courses limit a job to those spec ids / subjects (empty = everything). publish_live: true = at the end of every run, new notes are copied to the live site by themselves (only note files; nothing else goes live without the owner's OK).

jobs.prompt: You are a {board} GCSE {subject} examiner. Write revision flashcards for this ONE spec point from {board} {subject} {code} ({paper} > {topic}): "{point}". Each card has a short question q and a precise answer a in mark-scheme wording. Cover every fact, definition and equation the point needs. Also give one sentence, summary, saying what the point is about.
